full_page.content:
1950, May 19
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F. M. Cap. ( from the Photo-copy)
ST. FELIX FRIARY Route 8 Huntington, Indiana May 19, 1950
Blessed be God. In all His designs.
Miss G. L. Panyard First and Clay Streets Muskegon, Michigan
God Bless you Miss Grace Panyard -- you and all the Panyard Family and associates -- with customers, employes, debetors and creditors.
I do pray and hope things in God's own time and by His grace brighten up. You know as well as we all do that it has been quite a struggle for thousands of concerns to keep from bankrupsy this past winter.
Thanks be to God the Panyards still holding on -- and please God will be enabled to "make the grade." We shall try and speed up our prayers in this regard. I thank you for your favor just noted but while things are so shakey I hardly expect such donations. However it may be for the best anyhow.
Fr. Solanus, O. F. M. Cap.
The original in possession of: Doris Panyard 3248 Maple Grove Rd. Apt. 37 Muskegon, Mich. 49441
